rows.title: Fresh bounded devnet pilot run: funding, payout with crash-after-submit adoption, refund, on-chain refusal, ledger reconciliation
rows.steps: Label: fresh devnet pilot run (SQLite, server-held pilot keys). NOT the hosted integrated journey. Authorized by Hamza 2026-10-06 (relayed by pocketqa-lead): bounded fresh devnet-only test transactions with the existing ~/.config/pocketqa-devnet-pilot fixtures. Bounds stated BEFORE sending (in the runner and in d08-report.json bounds): funding <= 3,000,000 test-USDC units total; devnet SOL spent (fees AND rent) <= 50,000,000 lamports, live balance checked before every send (refuse past 45,000,000); raw sends outside the journal refused. Own worktree .worktrees/pqa-ios-e2e at 7beaad5 + runner test-live/pqa-ios-d08.live.test.ts (copied to evidence). Command: cd apps/api && POCKETQA_LIVE_D08=1 POCKETQA_LIVE_SQUADS_KEYS_DIR=~/.config/pocketqa-devnet-pilot D08_OUT=<evidence>/d08 D08_PRIVATE=<scratch file> npx vitest run --config vitest.live.config.ts test-live/pqa-ios-d08.live.test.ts, 2026-10-06T19:35:48Z to 19:37:20Z, exit 0. Flow (real API + worker + Squads adapter in-process, temporary SQLite): preflight reads -> study (2 slots x 1.00, escrow) -> funding request (adapter creates the multisig + vault token account) -> builder wallet funds 2.20 with the reference -> one tester (existing pilot tester key) approved -> payout with a simulated crash right after the execute LANDED, local squads_attempts wiped -> recovery -> close -> refund -> deliberate second execute (on-chain refusal) -> ledger books -> per-op RPC readback. Every send was journaled (operation id, decoded instructions, message sha256, signature prefix+sha256) and fsynced before sendTransaction. Original pilot receipts untouched.
